summary.hinglish: Article 22 ke under arrested person ko arrest ke grounds batane aur generally apni choice ke lawyer se advice aur defence lene ka right hota hai. Arrested person ko normally 24 hours ke andar magistrate ke saamne produce karna hota hai.
